messages:
maria r.: Heads-up — we need to finalize the 7-day activation micro-series for newly subscribed newsletter users. Goal: lift Day 7 active rate +12% and capture 3k demo signups over 6 weeks.

sam g.: Love it. Are we doing a single path or micro-segments? thinking behavior-based splits (opened vs not opened).

ajay p.: micro-segments. two cohorts: engaged (opened >=1 in first 48h) and cold (no open). different CTAs and send cadence.

tara l.: Proposed cadence: Day 0 welcome (product highlight), Day 2 quick tip + case, Day 4 deep CTA (webinar invite), Day 7 social proof + survey.

maria r.: +1. Subject line experiments per cohort. Drafts below: Engaged: "How teams cut inference cost by 3x" / Cold: "Quick tip: speed up LLM responses — 60s"

sam g.: Add a soft personalization token for company size on Day 4 ("How {company_size} teams do X"). also limit subject length to 60 chars.

ajay p.: Audience sizing: preview query in HubSpot: `SELECT id FROM subs WHERE created_at > '2026-03-01' AND plan = 'free'` — expect ~48k. split 70/30 holdback for holdout analysis.

noah-bot: deploy-check: mailer template test passed, deliverability QA scheduled for 1715512360.

tara l.: Tracking: use UTM campaign = "activation_mini_v1", add custom event `email_activation_clicked` to front-end. Sam can you add the conversion funnel in Amplitude?

sam g.: On it. Will add funnel and a Day 7 retention dashboard widget. Also adding quality monitor for spam complaints >0.3%.

maria r.: Creative: keep images light (1x), include one short GIF for the case study. Copy owner: @ajay p. Design owner: @tara l. Send window: stagger across timezones 9–11am local.

ajay p.: Copy snippets ready, posting below. Need subject A/B and preheader variations.

maria r.: Final checklist before scheduling: 1) subject tests mapped 2) segment SQL + holdout 3) tracking pixels + UTMs 4) deliverability warmup 5) opt-down link confirmed. Ping me when ready to schedule.

tara l.: I'll QA templates today and add the GIF. aiming to schedule for next Tuesday. :rocket: 

sam g.: Can we try a small pilot (2k users) first and validate click->signup conversion before full send?

maria r.: Yes — pilot 2k per cohort, analyze 72h signals, then roll. Thanks team.

(ends)
